1. Take the luma from 0 to 1 and its integral image.
2. At each filter size, compute the three box responses and the determinant at every pixel.
3. Keep maxima over position and size above the threshold, one per group of equal maxima.
4. Give each keypoint the dominant direction of its Haar wavelet responses.
5. Report the position, sigma, filter size, angle, determinant and the sign of the Laplacian.
